evidence.quote:
LiberAI
has introduced Liber-0, a world action model (WAM) pretrained on more than 2.2 million hours of human experience. The Beijing-based startup said the model combines human video with glove-recorded motion and embodiment-conditioned learning to transfer human manipulation experience to robots.
Here, zero-shot means the evaluated checkpoint was not trained on robot demonstrations collected specifically for these target tasks; pretraining still included robot data.

LiberAI reported task success rates of 63.5% on pick-and-place tasks, 34.0% on non-pick-and-place manipulation tasks and 10.5% on challenging non-pick-and-place and long-horizon tasks, with an overall success rate of 36.0% across 600 trials.

title: LiberAI Unveils Liber-0, a World Action Model That Grounds Human Experience in Robot Action
displayTitle: LiberAI发布Liber-0，尝试用人类动作数据训练机器人操作
summary: The Robot Report刊登LiberAI赞助内容，介绍Liber-0世界动作模型及其以人类视频和手套动作数据预训练的路线；60项任务的成功率为公司自测。
investorNote: 人类动作数据可降低逐任务遥操作采集成本，但零样本定义仍包含既有机器人预训练，距离稳定复杂操作有明显差距。
narrative: LiberAI在The Robot Report的赞助内容中介绍Liber-0，称模型使用超过220万小时的人类经验数据，并在60项由GPT-6提出的任务、600次试验中取得36%总体成功率。**这里的“零样本”只指没有为目标任务另采机器人示教**，预训练仍使用机器人数据；复杂长程任务成功率为10.5%。这条路线的价值是减少逐任务示教，但这些数字来自厂商测试，距离可持续部署还有明显验证空间。
